A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Sparfels and provide readable text, equations, figures, tables and supplementary material. Existing content can be matched despite moving the references before the supplementary material in v2.

before.justification: Sections 4-5 and the supplement report original reconstruction, novel-view synthesis, camera-pose, ablation and runtime results.

after.justification: V2 retains those original results and adds a color-variance trajectory, alternative-initialization examples and a prior-failure comparison.

M1.justification: Appendix D introduces a VGGT initialization variant using a feed-forward prior that avoids MASt3R's global alignment. The main MASt3R-based pipeline, 2DGS representation, losses and joint optimization remain unchanged.

E1.justification: The same datasets and reconstruction, novel-view synthesis and pose-estimation tasks are retained. The added diagnostics do not establish new data or task coverage; the sink scene in Figure 14 already appears in v1 Figure 7.

E2.justification: Tables 1-6 retain their comparator sets. Figure 14 adds a direct MASt3R-versus-Sparfels comparison for the sink-scene diagnostic; the earlier reconstruction display of that scene in Figure 7 compared InstantSplat2DGS.

E3.justification: New diagnostics monitor average color variance over 1,000 optimization steps and compare VGGT/MASt3R initialization with three images. Existing benchmark settings remain unchanged. The new failure example has an unresolved input-count discrepancy: Appendix F says six images, whereas Figure 14 says three.

E4.justification: Appendices C, D and F add a variance-loss trajectory diagnostic, an alternative-prior comparison and a targeted MASt3R failure case. These are limited supporting analyses alongside the unchanged quantitative component and input-view ablations.

E5.justification: Run-count, seed and statistical uncertainty reporting are unchanged, with no added confidence intervals or significance tests. Figure 12 measures rendered-color variance, not uncertainty across experimental runs.

E6.justification: Numerical entries in Tables 1-6 remain unchanged, including DTU mean Rel 4.82 and NC 0.857. Figures 12-14 add lower color-variance trajectories with the loss enabled and qualitative results for VGGT initialization and recovery from MASt3R errors.

T1.justification: Equations 1-12, including the worst-case objective and variance-based bound, are retained. Appendix E adds conceptual motivation about epistemic uncertainty and flat minima without introducing a new formal assumption, derivation or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same central contributions: fast sparse unposed reconstruction, foundation-model-initialized joint 2DGS optimization, color-variance regularization and strong reconstruction, rendering and pose-estimation performance.

C2.justification: Appendix E newly interprets regularization through epistemic geometry uncertainty and flat minima in density space. Appendices D and F discuss modularity across priors and recovery through test-time refinement of imperfect initialization. The main limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The advertised project/code address changes from Sparfels/ to Sparfels-web/, while both abstracts still describe code as forthcoming. Figures 9-10 newly specify three-image inputs. Existing implementation, hyperparameter, hardware and runtime disclosures remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Six references are added: VGGT, NeRF++, and works on flat minima, Entropy-SGD, sharpness-aware minimization and Bayesian learning. They support the new initialization example and regularization interpretation; the main related-work positioning is retained.

P1.justification: V2 makes scattered spelling, grammar and terminology corrections, adds equal-contribution notes, introduces short supplementary Sections C-F and moves references before the supplement. The main narrative and section organization remain substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: V2 adds Figures 12-14 and adjusts supplementary layout, captions and some table emphasis. Existing figure images are retained. Figure 5's right-hand crop is correctly relabeled as using the variance loss; v1 incorrectly labeled both crops as without it.

improvement.justification: The new diagnostics and initialization examples modestly strengthen supporting evidence, while expanded motivation and the corrected Figure 5 caption improve clarity. Central benchmark results are unchanged. The qualitative scope of the additions and the six-versus-three-image inconsistency in Appendix F/Figure 14 limit the improvement.
